categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Oulu Tong Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the switched-mode power supply industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of power adapters, data center power supplies, and other power products. Its products serve diverse applications including office electronics, network communications, security monitoring, smart homes, new consumer electronics, data centers, power battery equipment, pure electric vehicles, and chemical formation and capacity equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced power electronics technologies including semiconductor power devices, frequency conversion, electromagnetic technology, microprocessor control, and integrated automation. It employs a sales-driven production model with centralized procurement of key raw materials such as semiconductors, resistors, capacitors, magnetic materials, and wiring. The R&D process includes layered development from standard series to customized products with regional safety certifications, supported by multiple R&D centers and comprehensive testing labs. The company also focuses on high-power server power supplies, digital control, and energy monitoring technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic leading electronics and IT companies such as LG, HP, Honeywell, Roku, Google, Walmart, Foxconn, Hikvision, Dahua, Inspur, Lenovo, and ZTE. The company serves markets in office electronics, consumer electronics, data center infrastructure, industrial automation, communication equipment, security monitoring, smart home devices, electric tools, and new energy vehicles. The data center power supply segment targets server manufacturers and cloud service providers, while the power adapter segment focuses on consumer and office electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales presence in China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, the United States, Mexico, and Taiwan. It has manufacturing bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Ganzu, Suzhou, Hangzhou, Vietnam, and Mexico. Sales and customer service teams are established in China, Taiwan, and the US, supporting both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Oulu Tong operates primarily in the midstream segment of the power supply industry, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of power supply products. It procures raw materials such as semiconductors and magnetic components from upstream suppliers and sells finished power supply products directly to downstream brand owners and electronic manufacturing service providers, as well as through trade customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-power, high-efficiency, and high-density power supplies, especially for AI and data center applications. It invests in R&D for advanced server power supplies, GaN MOS multi-port smart PD power, digital PoE power, and immersion liquid cooling power systems. The R&D strategy balances standardization and customization, with dedicated project and pre-research teams to maintain technological leadership and respond to evolving customer needs. The company also focuses on expanding product categories and exploring new applications such as electric tools, electric vehicles, and smart home devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of power supply products including power adapters, data center power supplies, and other power products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to brand owners and electronic manufacturing service companies, supplemented by trade sales. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, including export customs clearance and vendor-managed inventory consumption.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading player in the switched-mode power supply industry in China, with strong brand recognition and technical capabilities. It competes with other domestic and international power supply manufacturers by leveraging product quality, technological innovation, and global production capacity. It holds a leading position in the domestic data center power supply market and is recognized for high-power server power supply products comparable to international high-end standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.8 billion, representing a 32.32% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 268 million, up 36.92%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 5.32 billion, growing 41.94% from the previous year. EBITDA increased by 31.68%, and the company maintained a healthy cash flow and a net asset return rate of 13.33%. The company has shown steady and high-quality growth with expanding scale and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Oulu Tong emphasizes reliable, efficient, and intelligent power supply solutions tailored to customer needs. Its competitive advantages include advanced R&D capabilities, comprehensive quality management with multiple international certifications, and a global production and service network. The company differentiates itself through high-power server power supplies with leading domestic and international technology, customized product offerings, and strong customer relationships with major global brands. It also focuses on innovation in AI-driven and high-density power solutions to meet emerging market demands.
